relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: intracolonic administration of PGE2 decreased SERT mRNA by 55.3%

relationships.subject: mast cells
relationships.evidence_quote: in response to IBS-D FS, mast cells synthesize and release PGE2

relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: in vitro studies demonstrated a dose-dependent increase in COX-2 expression (Figure 4D) and PGE2 release (Figure 4E) from cultured mouse mast cells in response to a 4-h LPS treatment

relationships.subject: EP2
relationships.evidence_quote: blocking PGE2 receptor EP2 by the EP2-specific antagonist PF-04418948 (10 mg/kg, ip) significantly diminished the inhibitory effect of IBS-D FS on colonic SERT expression

key_findings: Fecal LPS with trypsin from IBS-D patients stimulates mucosal mast cells to release COX-2-dependent PGE2, which downregulates epithelial SERT via EP2, raising mucosal 5-HT.
Reduced SERT drives motility, secretion and visceral hypersensitivity, blocked by ondansetron, cromolyn or EP2 antagonist.
